before.title: Palladia (toceranib) for canine oral melanoma
before.center: Ontario Veterinary College — University of Guelph
before.status: Actively recruiting — listed on current OVC canine oncology trials page
before.contacts: OVC Clinical Trials — ovc.clinicaltrials@uoguelph.ca; official study contact form
before.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. The study covers initial staging, Palladia medication and associated dispensing/administration fees.
before.notes: Treatment study for biopsy-confirmed canine oral melanoma with measurable disease. OVC states dogs with previous chemotherapy are not eligible; prior melanoma vaccination is allowed. Multiple OVC visits are required.

before.title: MRI-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) for canine limb osteosarcoma
before.center: Ontario Veterinary College / Hospital for Sick Children
before.status: Actively recruiting — listed on current OVC canine oncology trials page
before.contacts: OVC Clinical Trials — ovc.clinicaltrials@uoguelph.ca; official study contact form
before.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. The study covers MRI(s), HIFU treatment, associated anesthesia, study biopsies and analyses.
before.notes: Pilot treatment study for confirmed osteosarcoma of the distal radius with no evidence of metastasis. No previous surgery or radiation for the osteosarcoma. Prior chemotherapy and/or bisphosphonate treatment is evaluated case-by-case. Requires visits to SickKids in Toronto and OVC in Guelph.

after.title: MRI-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) for canine limb osteosarcoma
after.center: Ontario Veterinary College / Hospital for Sick Children
after.status: Actively recruiting — listed on current OVC canine oncology trials page
after.contacts: OVC Clinical Trials — ovc.clinicaltrials@uoguelph.ca; official study contact form
after.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. The study covers MRI(s), HIFU treatment, associated anesthesia, study biopsies and analyses.
after.notes: Pilot treatment study for confirmed osteosarcoma of the distal radius with no evidence of metastasis. No previous surgery or radiation for the osteosarcoma. Prior chemotherapy and/or bisphosphonate treatment is evaluated case-by-case. Requires visits to SickKids in Toronto and OVC in Guelph.
after.special_requirement: The osteosarcoma must be in the distal radius (lower forelimb); an appendicular/limb answer alone does not establish this location. The study team must confirm exact anatomy and any prior chemotherapy/bisphosphonate use.
